rules.description: Using a named argument whose name does not correspond to a parameter of the called function or method, will result in a TypeError at runtime.

rules.cwe_name: Generation of Predictable Numbers or Identifiers
rules.description: Tokens used for sensitive tasks, such as, password recovery, and email confirmation, should not use predictable values.

rules.cwe_name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
rules.description: Binding a socket to all interfaces opens it up to traffic from any IPv4 address and is therefore associated with security risks.

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Comparison
rules.description: A security-relevant comparison checks the wrong, incomplete, or non-canonical value.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection')
rules.description: user provided command can lead to execute code on a external server that can be belong to other users or admins

rules.cwe_name: Observable Timing Discrepancy
rules.description: When checking a Hash over a message, a constant-time algorithm should be used. Otherwise, an attacker may be able to forge a valid Hash for an arbitrary message by running a timing attack if they can send to the validation procedure. A successful attack can result in authentication bypass.

rules.cwe_name: Relative Path Traversal
rules.description: Accessing paths influenced by users can allow an attacker to access unexpected resources.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Data within XPath Expressions ('XPath Injection')
rules.description: Building a XPath query from user-controlled sources is vulnerable to insertion of malicious Xpath code by the user.

rules.cwe_name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
rules.description: Deserializing user-controlled data may allow attackers to execute arbitrary code.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrect Number of Arguments
rules.description: Using too many or too few arguments in a call to the `__init__` method of a class will result in a TypeError at runtime.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an LDAP Query ('LDAP Injection')
rules.description: Building an LDAP query from user-controlled sources is vulnerable to insertion of malicious LDAP code by the user.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Authorization
rules.description: Not using `pam_acct_mgmt` after `pam_authenticate` to check the validity of a login can lead to authorization bypass.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')
rules.description: Building a SQL query from user-controlled sources is vulnerable to insertion of malicious SQL code by the user.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Link Resolution Before File Access ('Link Following')
rules.description: File access follows a symlink, hardlink, or shortcut to an unintended resource.
